api_tokens.ddl:
CREATE TABLE api_tokens (
	id SERIAL NOT NULL, 
	jti VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	user_id VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, 
	name VARCHAR(200), 
	expires_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	last_used_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	revoked_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	UNIQUE (jti)
)

balance_terminal_tsp.ddl:
CREATE TABLE balance_terminal_tsp (
	rec_id SERIAL NOT NULL, 
	int_day INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	org_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	terminal_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	tsp_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	menu_snapshot_id INTEGER, 
	menu_version INTEGER, 
	amount BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	count INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	update_datetime TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (rec_id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_balance_day_terminal_tsp_ver UNIQUE (int_day, terminal_id, tsp_id, menu_version), 
	FOREIGN KEY(org_id) REFERENCES orgs (org_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(terminal_id) REFERENCES terminals (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(tsp_id) REFERENCES tsp (tsp_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(menu_snapshot_id) REFERENCES menu_variant_snapshots (id) ON DELETE SET NULL
)

billing_order_items.ddl:
CREATE TABLE billing_order_items (
	id SERIAL NOT NULL, 
	order_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	terminal_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	operation VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	periods_due INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	advance_periods INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	billing_period_months INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	monthly_price_minor BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	amount_minor BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	old_expires_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	new_expires_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	cert_policy_snapshot JSONB, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_billing_order_items_operation CHECK (operation IN ('renewal', 'reactivation', 'cert_pin')), 
	FOREIGN KEY(order_id) REFERENCES billing_orders (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(terminal_id) REFERENCES terminals (id)
)

billing_orders.ddl:
CREATE TABLE billing_orders (
	id UUID NOT NULL, 
	org_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(20) DEFAULT 'pending' NOT NULL, 
	currency VARCHAR(3) DEFAULT 'RUB' NOT NULL, 
	amount_minor BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	provider VARCHAR(50), 
	provider_order_id VARCHAR(200), 
	payment_url TEXT, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	paid_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	expires_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)

catalog_categories.ddl:
CREATE TABLE catalog_categories (
	id SERIAL NOT NULL, 
	org_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	parent_id INTEGER, 
	sort_order INTEGER DEFAULT '0' NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(parent_id) REFERENCES catalog_categories (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)

catalog_items.ddl:
CREATE TABLE catalog_items (
	id SERIAL NOT NULL, 
	org_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	category_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	tsp_code INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	printname VARCHAR(255), 
	price INTEGER DEFAULT '0' NOT NULL, 
	protypenumber INTEGER DEFAULT '0' NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_catalog_org_tsp UNIQUE (org_id, tsp_code), 
	FOREIGN KEY(category_id) REFERENCES catalog_categories (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)

certificate_pins.ddl:
CREATE TABLE certificate_pins (
	id SERIAL NOT NULL, 
	pin VARCHAR(10) NOT NULL, 
	terminal_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	org_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	order_item_id INTEGER, 
	created_by VARCHAR(100), 
	creation_source VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	payment_required BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	expires_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	used_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_certificate_pins_status CHECK (status IN ('pending', 'used', 'expired', 'cancelled')), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_certificate_pins_creation_source CHECK (creation_source IN ('tenant', 'global_admin', 'system')), 
	UNIQUE (pin), 
	FOREIGN KEY(terminal_id) REFERENCES terminals (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(order_item_id) REFERENCES billing_order_items (id)
)

email_logs.ddl:
CREATE TABLE email_logs (
	id SERIAL NOT NULL, 
	org_id INTEGER, 
	user_id INTEGER, 
	device_id VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, 
	recipients VARCHAR(1000) NOT NULL, 
	subject VARCHAR(500), 
	status VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL, 
	postbox_message_id VARCHAR(255), 
	storage_path VARCHAR(1000), 
	error_message TEXT, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(org_id) REFERENCES orgs (org_id) ON DELETE SET NULL, 
	FOREIGN KEY(user_id) REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE SET NULL
)

email_verifications.ddl:
CREATE TABLE email_verifications (
	id SERIAL NOT NULL, 
	org_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	user_id INTEGER, 
	email VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	token_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	otp_code VARCHAR(6) NOT NULL, 
	attempts_left INTEGER DEFAULT '5' NOT NULL, 
	expires_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	is_used BOOLEAN DEFAULT 'false' NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(org_id) REFERENCES orgs (org_id) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	FOREIGN KEY(user_id) REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE SET NULL
)
indexes: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ix_email_verifications_token_hash ON email_verifications (token_hash)

gate_gauge_records.ddl:
CREATE TABLE gate_gauge_records (
	id SERIAL NOT NULL, 
	device_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	sn VARCHAR(100), 
	gauge_data JSONB NOT NULL, 
	raw_data TEXT, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)

groups.ddl:
CREATE TABLE groups (
	id SERIAL NOT NULL, 
	menu_variant_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	org_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	number INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	parent_id INTEGER, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(menu_variant_id) REFERENCES menu_variants (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	FOREIGN KEY(parent_id) REFERENCES groups (id) ON DELETE SET NULL
)

licenses.ddl:
CREATE TABLE licenses (
	id SERIAL NOT NULL, 
	terminal_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	org_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	license_type VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL, 
	expires_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	balance INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	billing_period_months SMALLINT DEFAULT '1' NOT NULL, 
	monthly_price_override_minor BIGINT, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_license_price_non_negative CHECK (monthly_price_override_minor >= 0), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_billing_period_months_positive CHECK (billing_period_months > 0), 
	FOREIGN KEY(terminal_id) REFERENCES terminals (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)

menu_variant_snapshots.ddl:
CREATE TABLE menu_variant_snapshots (
	id SERIAL NOT NULL, 
	menu_variant_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	version INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	snapshot_data JSONB NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_snapshot_variant_version UNIQUE (menu_variant_id, version), 
	FOREIGN KEY(menu_variant_id) REFERENCES menu_variants (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)
indexes: CREATE INDEX idx_snapshot_variant_version ON menu_variant_snapshots (menu_variant_id, version)

menu_variants.ddl:
CREATE TABLE menu_variants (
	id SERIAL NOT NULL, 
	org_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	version INTEGER DEFAULT '1' NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_menu_variants_org_name UNIQUE (org_id, name)
)

org_billing_settings.ddl:
CREATE TABLE org_billing_settings (
	org_id SERIAL NOT NULL, 
	monthly_price_minor BIGINT DEFAULT '100000' NOT NULL, 
	currency VARCHAR(3) DEFAULT 'RUB' NOT NULL, 
	billing_mode VARCHAR(30) DEFAULT 'standard' NOT NULL, 
	min_billing_periods INTEGER DEFAULT '1' NOT NULL, 
	allowed_billing_periods VARCHAR(50), 
	default_selection_mode VARCHAR(30) DEFAULT 'all_due' NOT NULL, 
	cert_billing_mode VARCHAR(20) DEFAULT 'none' NOT NULL, 
	cert_price_minor BIGINT, 
	tenant_pin_creation_enabled BOOLEAN DEFAULT 'false' NOT NULL, 
	cert_charge_primary_issue BOOLEAN DEFAULT 'true' NOT NULL, 
	cert_charge_reissue BOOLEAN DEFAULT 'true' NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (org_id), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_org_billing_price_non_negative CHECK (monthly_price_minor >= 0), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_org_cert_price_non_negative CHECK (cert_price_minor IS NULL OR cert_price_minor >= 0), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_org_cert_mode CHECK (cert_billing_mode IN ('none', 'per_operation'))
)

org_statuses.ddl:
CREATE TABLE org_statuses (
	id SERIAL NOT NULL, 
	org_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	UNIQUE (org_id)
)

orgs.ddl:
CREATE TABLE orgs (
	org_id SERIAL NOT NULL, 
	org_name VARCHAR(150) NOT NULL, 
	name VARCHAR(150) NOT NULL, 
	status INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	is_active BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	timezone VARCHAR(64) DEFAULT 'Europe/Moscow' NOT NULL, 
	email VARCHAR(255), 
	phone VARCHAR(50), 
	notify_by_email BOOLEAN DEFAULT 'true' NOT NULL, 
	send_reports BOOLEAN DEFAULT 'true' NOT NULL, 
	is_email_verified BOOLEAN DEFAULT 'false' NOT NULL, 
	email_verified_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (org_id)
)

payment_params.ddl:
CREATE TABLE payment_params (
	id SERIAL NOT NULL, 
	paym_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	param_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	param_value VARCHAR(2000), 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(paym_id) REFERENCES payments (paym_id) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	FOREIGN KEY(param_id) REFERENCES tsp_parameter_codes (param_id)
)

payments.ddl:
CREATE TABLE payments (
	paym_id SERIAL NOT NULL, 
	paym_datetime TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	paym_amount BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	paym_ext_id VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	paym_tsp_code INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	terminal_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	org_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	paym_state INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	pay_type_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	menu_snapshot_id INTEGER, 
	menu_version INTEGER, 
	PRIMARY KEY (paym_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(terminal_id) REFERENCES terminals (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(org_id) REFERENCES orgs (org_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(menu_snapshot_id) REFERENCES menu_variant_snapshots (id) ON DELETE SET NULL
)
indexes: CREATE INDEX idx_payments_tsp_code_menu_version ON payments (paym_tsp_code, menu_version)

services.ddl:
CREATE TABLE services (
	id SERIAL NOT NULL, 
	menu_variant_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	group_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	tsp_code INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	printname VARCHAR(255), 
	price INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	protypenumber INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	catalog_item_id INTEGER, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_service_variant_tsp UNIQUE (menu_variant_id, tsp_code), 
	FOREIGN KEY(menu_variant_id) REFERENCES menu_variants (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	FOREIGN KEY(group_id) REFERENCES groups (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	FOREIGN KEY(catalog_item_id) REFERENCES catalog_items (id) ON DELETE SET NULL
)

tech_gate_records.ddl:
CREATE TABLE tech_gate_records (
	id SERIAL NOT NULL, 
	device_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	sn VARCHAR(100), 
	function_name VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL, 
	request_data JSONB NOT NULL, 
	raw_params TEXT, 
	response_status VARCHAR(20), 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)

terminal_cert_discovery.ddl:
CREATE TABLE terminal_cert_discovery (
	id SERIAL NOT NULL, 
	sn VARCHAR(100), 
	cert_serial VARCHAR(100), 
	cert_dn VARCHAR(500), 
	ou VARCHAR(50), 
	o VARCHAR(50), 
	is_valid BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	validation_status VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL, 
	terminal_id INTEGER, 
	db_cert_serial VARCHAR(100), 
	request_count INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	last_endpoint VARCHAR(100), 
	client_ip VARCHAR(50), 
	first_seen_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	last_seen_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(terminal_id) REFERENCES terminals (id) ON DELETE SET NULL
)
indexes: CREATE INDEX idx_terminal_cert_discovery_sn_serial ON terminal_cert_discovery (sn, cert_serial)

terminal_cert_history.ddl:
CREATE TABLE terminal_cert_history (
	id SERIAL NOT NULL, 
	terminal_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	cert_serial VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, 
	not_valid_after TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	pin_id INTEGER, 
	source VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	issued_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(terminal_id) REFERENCES terminals (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(pin_id) REFERENCES certificate_pins (id)
)

terminal_gauge_states.ddl:
CREATE TABLE terminal_gauge_states (
	device_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	sn VARCHAR(100), 
	updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	last_tick_epoch INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	slots_bitmask INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	gauge_data JSONB NOT NULL, 
	last_payment_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	last_inkass_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	license_expires_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	internal_enrichment JSONB NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (device_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(device_id) REFERENCES terminals (device_id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)

terminal_menu_bindings.ddl:
CREATE TABLE terminal_menu_bindings (
	id SERIAL NOT NULL, 
	device_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	menu_variant_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	loaded_version INTEGER, 
	loaded_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(menu_variant_id) REFERENCES menu_variants (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)
indexes: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ix_terminal_menu_bindings_device_id ON terminal_menu_bindings (device_id)

terminal_types.ddl:
CREATE TABLE terminal_types (
	id SERIAL NOT NULL, 
	name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, 
	description VARCHAR(255), 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)

terminals.ddl:
CREATE TABLE terminals (
	id SERIAL NOT NULL, 
	device_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	sn VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, 
	cert_serial VARCHAR(100), 
	cert_not_valid_after TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	org_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	is_active BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	timezone VARCHAR(64), 
	address VARCHAR(500), 
	note VARCHAR(500), 
	terminal_type_id INTEGER DEFAULT '0' NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	show_in_monitoring BOOLEAN DEFAULT 'true' NOT NULL, 
	iot_provisioned BOOLEAN DEFAULT 'false' NOT NULL, 
	iot_provisioned_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	iot_last_sync_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	iot_is_online BOOLEAN DEFAULT 'false' NOT NULL, 
	iot_last_connected_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	UNIQUE (device_id), 
	UNIQUE (sn), 
	FOREIGN KEY(terminal_type_id) REFERENCES terminal_types (id)
)

tsp.ddl:
CREATE TABLE tsp (
	tsp_id SERIAL NOT NULL, 
	tsp_code INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	tsp_name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (tsp_id), 
	UNIQUE (tsp_code)
)

tsp_parameter_codes.ddl:
CREATE TABLE tsp_parameter_codes (
	param_id SERIAL NOT NULL, 
	prototypenumber INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	parameter_code INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	code_description VARCHAR(255), 
	PRIMARY KEY (param_id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_prototype_param_code UNIQUE (prototypenumber, parameter_code)
)

user_sessions.ddl:
CREATE TABLE user_sessions (
	id SERIAL NOT NULL, 
	user_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	refresh_token VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	refresh_token_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	ip_address VARCHAR(45), 
	user_agent VARCHAR(500), 
	expires_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	last_used_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	is_revoked BOOLEAN DEFAULT 'false' NOT NULL, 
	active_org_id INTEGER, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(user_id) REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)
indexes: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ix_user_sessions_refresh_token_hash ON user_sessions (refresh_token_hash)

users.ddl:
CREATE TABLE users (
	id SERIAL NOT NULL, 
	username VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, 
	md5_password VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	org_id INTEGER, 
	role_id INTEGER DEFAULT '3' NOT NULL, 
	role VARCHAR(30) DEFAULT 'user' NOT NULL, 
	is_active BOOLEAN DEFAULT 'true' NOT NULL, 
	is_superuser BOOLEAN DEFAULT 'false' NOT NULL, 
	last_org_id INTEGER, 
	full_name VARCHAR(255), 
	permissions JSONB DEFAULT '[]'::jsonb NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT chk_users_role4_tenant CHECK (role_id != 4 OR (org_id IS NOT NULL AND org_id > 0)), 
	FOREIGN KEY(org_id) REFERENCES orgs (org_id) ON DELETE SET NULL
)
indexes: CREATE INDEX idx_users_permissions ON users USING gin (permissions)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ix_users_username ON users (username)
